finding.risk: Registering new ITEMS without new consumers would silently produce zero/incomplete effects.

clean_slate.rule: Target runtime knows only canonical new slots/stats.

recommended_equipped_shape.rationale: One uniform representation handles single and multi-capacity slots without mixed string/array types.

preconditions: item exists in player inventory exactly once
success: remove exactly one itemId from inventory
equip_operation.full_slot_behavior: Reject and ask player to unequip/replace explicitly; do not guess which ring/treasure to replace.

success: remove selected equipped instance from canonical slot
return exactly one itemId to inventory

stat_aggregation.rule: Bind fields to their exact NEW_COMBAT_STATS semantics. Do not convert through ataque/daño legacy fields or invent replacement formulas.
stat_aggregation.fail_closed: If any ratified field lacks a runtime consumer, integration is blocked rather than silently ignored.

anillo_hierro_oxidado.rule: Do not fake this as qi_max or legacy qi_med. Bind only when the meditation contract explicitly supports it.

espejo_pulso_velado.rule: Bind to canonical absorption/combat effect pipeline; never emulate it as flat DEF.

display.statsItem: Must render canonical new stat names/effects; remove ataque/daño/qi_med legacy rendering for new equipment.
display.statsCortos: Same canonical source; display-only, never economic/combat authority.

save.persist: canonical item IDs + canonical equipped slot arrays only

slice1_dependency.rule: Slice1 purchase is not productively complete until this item can be equipped and its canonical stats affect the new combat stat view.

required_tests: all other slots reject second item
equip removes exactly one inventory instance
all ratified stat fields have explicit consumers
save/load round-trip preserves canonical slot arrays
calzas_sendero_pinos changes expected new-combat stats after equip

ratification.note: Ratified as clean-slate design authority. Runtime integration remains a separate future step.
